title: debark lock v1
description: debark.lock/v1 - exactly what the online solve chose and why: the install plan (exact versions, ADR-007) and the provenance record for every file that crosses the gap. Written as lock.json at the root of a bundle. Never mutated once a bundle is exported; a re-run produces a new lock.

created_at.description: When this plan was produced, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

snapshot_digest.description: Canonical digest of the snapshot this plan was resolved against.

request_digest.description: Canonical digest of the BuildRequest, so a rerun with identical inputs is recognisable.

target.description: The target identity this plan is valid for; install refuses a mismatched architecture.

resolver.description: Which apt, where, and under which policy made the decisions in this lock.

packages.description: Every file in the bundle pool, sorted by (name, arch, version).

install.description: The exact set install must request, in name=version form, sorted. The subset of packages that was requested or is needed by a requested package - never the whole pool.

closed_world_check.description: Result of resolving the finished bundle against itself, offline, before export (ADR-007).

warnings.description: Structured warnings this plan carries: phasing fallback, solver divergence, redistribution flags, unverified URLs.

unresolved.description: Inputs apt could not satisfy. Non-empty here corresponds to exit code 3.

stats.description: Summary of this run against the previous state of the output bundle.

backend.description: Where resolution actually ran. Never "auto": that value only ever appears at request time and is resolved to one of these two before it is recorded.

image.description: Container image reference used, when backend is "container".

image_digest.description: The resolved container image digest, OCI form ("sha256:" prefix plus 64 lowercase hex characters).

apt_version.description: Version of the apt that actually ran the resolution.

dpkg_version.description: Version of dpkg that actually ran alongside it.

apt_options.description: Every -o option passed to apt-get, sorted, so the run is reproducible.

phased_updates.description: The phased-update policy that applied: the target's own machine-id was used, or only fully-phased versions were considered (ADR-006).

install_recommends.description: The effective APT::Install-Recommends value used for this resolution.

solver_divergence.description: Set when the resolving apt's major.minor version differed from the target's, explaining a possible future discrepancy.

arch.description: dpkg architecture of this file, e.g. "amd64" or "all".

source_package.description: Source package name (without version), for redistribution and corresponding-source questions.

filename.description: Path inside the bundle, e.g. pool/v/vlc/vlc_3.0.21-1build1_amd64.deb.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the .deb file.

reason.description: Why this file is in the bundle: requested, upgrade, external, or dependency-of:<pkg> naming the package that pulled it in.

publisher_verification.description: Strength of the provenance claim for this file. HTTPS alone is not provenance: a plain URL download is url-unverified.

flags.description: Redistribution and doctor findings for this file. Informational: no flag alone blocks a build.

essential.description: True for packages the dpkg fallback must unpack before others.

uri.description: Archive URI or vendor URL this file was fetched from; empty for a local file input.

local_path.description: Operator-supplied path for a local file input, recorded as given.

suite.description: Archive suite the file was listed in, e.g. "bookworm".

release_digest.description: SHA-256 of the InRelease/Release file that authenticated the index listing this file.

key_fingerprint.description: Uppercase hex fingerprint of the archive key that signed that Release.

result.description: Outcome of the pre-export offline resolution proof.

command_digest.description: Canonical digest of the argv that was run.

output_digest.description: SHA-256 of the captured command output.

detail.description: One-line explanation of a failure or a skip.

packages.description: Package names this warning applies to, when relevant.

kind.description: What kind of input this was.

missing.description: Dependency names that could not be satisfied, when they could be extracted.

added.description: Files newly added to the bundle by this run.

unchanged.description: Files already present and untouched by this run.

bytes.description: Total bytes in the resulting bundle pool.

downloaded_bytes.description: Bytes that actually crossed the network this run; the remainder came from the local store.
